image_description: A Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) lying on a wooden floor next to a wooden bench or furniture piece. The dog has the characteristic red and white coat pattern, long feathered ears, and is resting with its head down. Background includes a patterned cushion on the bench and a potted plant in the corner.
